parameters.formDescription: Submit an approved research workload to the KFI-MAI Slurm cluster.

parameters.command:
set -e

SSH="sudo -n ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=5 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new"

$SSH ubuntu@hpc-controller "test -x '{{ $json.script }}'"

$SSH ubuntu@hpc-controller "sudo -n -u researcher1 sbatch --parsable --job-name='{{ $json.jobName }}' --partition='{{ $json.partition }}' --cpus-per-task='{{ $json.cpus }}' --time='{{ $json.timeLimit }}' '{{ $json.script }}'"

SSH="sudo -n ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=5 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new"

$SSH ubuntu@hpc-controller "squeue -h -j {{ $json.job_id }} -o '%i|%j|%T|%M|%P|%N' 2>/dev/null || true"
